what_differs: On 2026-09-30 the team decided that a rep completes a redeposit by entering proof and the actual amount, other details auto-populate, and completed records move to a locked, non-editable completed queue. WAGR-464 states only that a BA 'logs proof for each one'; the actual-amount field, auto-population and the lock are not in any ticket.
suggested_action: Suggestion: add the completion field set and the post-completion lock to WAGR-464 and to the completion build story.
